prompt:
A full-fidelity desktop website design comp, 16:9 landscape, showing the top of the page at 1440 px wide, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no browser window around the page, no device). The website for PrismTTY, a live terminal-output highlighter for network engineers, executed as a dark developer-tool landing page at Linear's level of craft, with a composition the category would not attempt: the hero IS the product's mechanism, a stream of terminal text passing through a prism.

Ground: near-black (#0a0b0d) with very subtle dark video texture behind it (faint out-of-focus light refracting through glass, barely visible, low contrast). Text #f2f3f5, secondary #8b9099, hairlines #23252a, one refined sans for type and a clean monospace for code.

Regions:
1. Top navigation: at left a small prism-triangle logo mark (an outlined triangle with a tiny terminal window inside) and the wordmark "PrismTTY"; at right "Profiles", "Install", "Docs", "GitHub".
2. Upper left: a large tight headline "Readable output, live in your terminal." with a one-line lede under it "PrismTTY colors the output already flowing through your shell, SSH sessions, pipes and logs." and an install chip "$ brew install inxbit/tap/prismtty" with a copy icon plus a ghost button "View on GitHub".
3. The focal element, spanning the full page width across the middle and lower half: one continuous horizontal band of monospace terminal output, the same eight lines of a Cisco session running left to right. On the left 45 percent the lines are raw, all flat gray: "edge-sw1#show interfaces description", "Gi1/0/1  up  up  Uplink to core-rtr", "Gi1/0/2  down  down  Spare access port", "Po10  up  up  Bundle to dist-a", "O  192.0.2.0/24 [110/20] via 198.51.100.1, Vlan1191". At the seam stands a large, crisp, precisely drawn glass prism outline (the logo's triangle, about 300 px tall, thin light-gray strokes, physically plausible refraction lines, no glow). To the right of the prism the very same lines continue, now highlighted exactly like real PrismTTY output: prompts pure white, interface names bright blue #0099ff, every "up" pure green #00ff00, "down" bold pure red #ff0000, IP addresses cyan #00ffff. A small caption under the band in secondary gray: "Real PrismTTY output, cisco profile."
4. At the bottom edge, the start of the next section: three small columns with headings "Follows every hop", "Nine built-in profiles", "Nothing stored by default".

Exact, calm, premium. No rainbow gradients, no neon glow, no gradient blobs. Real readable text at real size, about 16 px body on a 1440 px page.
